lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with approximately 4-6 spots per visible column and uniform horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots to form a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the upper surface to shadow on the lower surface.
